newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices slide after initial rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices slide after initial rise.

text.p: Indian castor prices for March delivery fell on Monday after an initial rise sparked by reports of floods in Brazil, dealers said.
They said prices first rose from 1,181/1,182 rupees to 1,186/1,187 rupees but later on higher prices attracted bull liquidation and prices slid.
"Brazil is a major producer of castorseed besides India and floods there may affect crop loss which in turn could brighten Indian export prospects," one dealer said.
Groundnut oil rose modestly to 345/346 rupees per 10 kg from 343 rupees on fresh physical buying and limited arrivals of 60/70 tonnes. Daily arrivals last week averaged 80/100 tonnes.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg.
